explanation: Merges main (#100, #101) into the IME fix. From main: Merges main (#101). From main: searchSummaries.ts adds the Visium reference and a regional summary, and portalCards.tsx adds the full-row HYPOMAP Visium tile and its drill. From this branch: atlas.ts reads each HypoMap study card into named AtlasDataset fields (publication with an http(s)-only link, technology, cells or nuclei, sampled region, sex, age stage, condition, cells in HypoMap), blank as null; the gated By dataset view shows them on each checked dataset card, and the by-dataset CSV appends Publication and Technology. Co-detection still reads only the wire labels. From this branch: UnifiedSearchBox's keydown handler returns early while an IME is composing, so arrows move IME candidates instead of the option highlight and Escape cancels composition without closing the list; Enter still goes through native form submission.
